description:
£150 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this impressive three bedroom property, ideally located in the heart of Jesmond and perfect for a group looking ahead to the next academic year.

Situated on the first floor, this spacious flat offers three generously sized double bedrooms, a large living room boasting high ceilings and decorative coving, two bathrooms and a well equipped kitchen complete with a dining area.

The property enjoys a fantastic location, with Tesco, the popular bars and restaurants of Osborne Road and West Jesmond Metro Station all just a short walk away.

Offering spacious accommodation, character features and an excellent location, this property is not to be missed!

Early viewings are highly recommended! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our lettings team to arrange your viewing.
